title: PAD video mode document, format 1
description: One file: <project>/modes/<slug>/video_mode.json. The plan (docs/plans/video_mode_maker.md) explains every field. The app (pinball_decryptor/core/video_mode/document.py) and the tests both load this file; nothing else describes the format.

format.description: The document's format number. A later PAD migrates an older number step by step; an older PAD refuses a newer one.

combo.description: PAD-1666: kills close together chain a combo; every `every` adds 1 to a multiplier on their points.

editor.description: The editor's own state (zoom, guides, open panels). Kept and written back; the engine never reads it.

dots.description: Dot-matrix screens: the 4:1 band of the stage they show (1360x340 from band_top).

fade_s.description: Music: the seconds this bed fades in over when it takes over from another (the one before fades out over the same), and out over when it stops. Absent: 1.

tempo_bpm.description: Music: its beats a minute, the beat grid a rhythm phase on this music reads and the timeline draws.

beat_offset_s.description: Music: where its first beat falls, in seconds from the start of the file.

beats_per_bar.description: Music: beats a bar (the grid's strong lines). Absent: 4.

face.description: The card's own font name, or a font file in the mode folder.

outline.description: PAD-1666: the outline baked round each glyph, px (absent: a twelfth of the size, at least 2).

trail.description: PAD-1666: a trail of particles it leaves behind.

layout.description: per_play: spawns and choices drawn from a new seed each play; fixed: the same every time, so it can be learned.

tracks.description: PAD-1664: the timeline's keyframed motion of placed things.

sound_track.description: PAD-1664: the timeline's sounds at set times.

align.description: Words: which edge x is (auto: by where x is on the stage).

outline.description: Words: an outline in this colour (the font's own outline glyphs).

shadow.description: Words: a drop shadow in this colour.

gradient.description: Words: the fill runs from colour at the top to this at the bottom.

danger.description: The colour it turns, pulsing, at or under `low` (health, lives, timer, meter).

low.description: Danger from this share of full down (absent: 0.34).

zones.description: A meter's danger zones: a band of the bar; the fill takes the zone's colour and pulses inside it.

count_up.description: Seconds a number takes to roll up to a new one.

on.description: A pop-up's happenings: it rises from where each happened (absent: kill).

rise.description: A pop-up rises this far, px.

picture.description: Pips, hearts, lives: frame 0 full, frame 1 empty.

blink.description: The player blinks while it cannot be hurt.

pulse.description: Danger pulses; a changed number pops.

kill.description: A particle's id, a preset (spark, smoke, debris, glow), or none.

hurt.description: A particle's id, a preset (spark, smoke, debris, glow), or none.

pickup.description: A particle's id, a preset (spark, smoke, debris, glow), or none.

hit.description: A particle's id, a preset (spark, smoke, debris, glow), or none.

fire.description: A particle's id, a preset (spark, smoke, debris, glow), or none.

boss.description: A particle's id, a preset (spark, smoke, debris, glow), or none.

multiplier_in.description: A multiplier earned in the pinball game before the video mode starts scales its score.

declinable.description: Offer the player a choice: play it or take decline_score (ST:TNG Holodeck).

from_attract.description: Also playable on its own from attract mode (Stern's challenge menus, Jaws Shark Hunter).

key.description: PAD-1664: one keyframe. at_s is seconds into the phase's play. A motion key has x, y (where the thing's anchor is) and may have bezier handles: out (towards the next key) and in (from the one before), each [dx, dy] stage px about the key. A scale, turn or alpha key has v; a tint key has tint. ease (or curve) is how it moves on to the next key.

curve.description: An easing curve of its own, as CSS cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2); x1 and x2 within 0..1. Takes the place of ease.

track.description: PAD-1664: one property of one placed thing, keyframed over the phase's play. place is the index of the thing in the phase's place list.

timed_sound.description: PAD-1664: a sound played at a set time of the phase's play.

particle.description: PAD-1666: a particle burst or trail, from a preset with what it changes.
